decode_parity.question: why does Bonsai PQ2_0 f16 decode match Qwen3.8-27B Q6_K q8/q8?
decode_parity.answer: It does not, against unspeculated Qwen. It matches Qwen WITH draft-mtp speculation.

bandwidth.conclusion: Qwen is near bandwidth-bound (81% of 640 GB/s); Bonsai's ternary kernel reaches only ~51%, so a 3.2x smaller file yields only ~2x decode. The parity is with Qwen's speculated 46 t/s, not its 22.8 unspeculated.

draft-mtp.detail: llama-server fails to load (exit 1) - Bonsai 2 has no MTP heads

draft-dspark.detail: server starts, but no drafter exists; draft_n null, no speculation

ngram.note: ngram needs no drafter; tested with the chat template, fresh server per rep, 3 reps, n_predict 256, PQ2_0 q8_0/q8_0 ctx 16384
ngram.conclusion: No real speedup in normal chat serving (within noise, sometimes slower). A raw-prompt continuation produced 92-108 t/s with acceptance 1.0, but that is an artifact of highly repetitive output, not representative.

slots.note: PQ2_0, ctx 262144 total, slots share the context pool (n_ctx_slot = 262144/N)
slots.conclusion: 64 slots fit with q8_0/q8_0 (26.35 GiB, 82.7%); 128 slots fit with q4_0/q4_0 at 99.7% but leave only 2048 ctx/slot. The binding constraint is context-per-slot, not VRAM.

intelligence.qwen38_q6k_q8q8_chat: BLOCKED - host swap exhausted (23/23 GiB) and no passwordless sudo; 22.9 GB model load ran 40 min without finishing twice
intelligence.architecture_note: Bonsai 2 is a ternary quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, the same base as Qwen3.8-27B-Q6_K. The comparison isolates weight quantization (2.13 vs 6.56 bpw); KV is q8_0/q8_0 in both.
intelligence.model_card_claim: 98.2% of FP16 intelligence retained; 84.78 avg across 14 thinking benchmarks vs 72.59 for IQ2_XXS and within 0.4 of UD-Q4_K_XL
